integrity: The proof is presented with explicit quantitative error bounds; finite diagnostics are supplemental and no independent scientific audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The asymptotic applies to moment sequences with a polynomial tail remainder; it does not resolve general slower tails, a next coefficient when c=0, singular values, or classes other than Hilbert–Schmidt. The novelty comparison is best-knowledge and does not certify absence from all earlier literature.
title: A universal square-root Hilbert–Schmidt cusp for power-damped Hankel moments
